source.title: extra-eyes manual tick and profile resolution cargo test pass

acquisition.details: Ran `cargo test` after adding `eyes tick` and git diff context construction. Result: 15 unit tests passed and 20 integration tests passed. Coverage includes manual tick running the project default raw watcher, git diff file/diff context in the watcher stdin envelope, hook fetch seeing the tick-produced message, project profile precedence over user profile for same name, bundled default profile resolution, and adding a new profile after daemon start then running it without daemon restart.
